arxiv-2012-06894.title: On the decoding of lattices constructed via a single parity check
arxiv-2012-06894.creator: Vincent Corlay, Joseph J. Boutros, Philippe Ciblat, Loïc Brunel
arxiv-2012-06894.description: Abstract This paper investigates the decoding of a remarkable set of lattices: We treat in a unified framework the Leech lattice in dimension 24, the Nebe lattice in dimension 72, and the Barnes-Wall lattices. A new interesting lattice is constructed as a simple application of single parity-check principle on the Leech lattice.

arxiv-2105-12120.title: Sampling random graphs with specified degree sequences
arxiv-2105-12120.creator: Upasana Dutta, Bailey K. Fosdick, Aaron Clauset
arxiv-2105-12120.description: Abstract The configuration model is a standard tool for uniformly generating random graphs with a specified degree sequence, and is often used as a null model to evaluate how much of an observed network’s structure can be explained by its degree structure alone.

arxiv-2112-13181.title: DeepMTL Pro: Deep Learning Based Multiple Transmitter Localization and Power Estimation
arxiv-2112-13181.creator: Caitao Zhan, Mohammad Ghaderibaneh, Pranjal Sahu, Himanshu Gupta
arxiv-2112-13181.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the problem of Multiple Transmitter Localization ( MTL ). MTL is to determine the locations of potential multiple transmitters in a field, based on readings from a distributed set of sensors. In contrast to the widely studied single transmitter localization problem, the MTL problem has only been studied recently in a few works.

arxiv-2205-13465.title: Galactic winds and bubbles from nuclear starburst rings numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , Cholla ( Schneider & Robertson 2015 ) , pyatomdb ( Foster & Heuer 2020 ) , yt ( Turk et al. 2011 )
arxiv-2205-13465.creator: Dustin D. Nguyen, Todd A. Thompson
arxiv-2205-13465.description: Abstract Galactic outflows from local starburst galaxies typically exhibit a layered geometry, with cool 10 4 10^{4}\, K flow sheathing a hotter 10 7 10^{7}\, K, cylindrically-collimated, X-ray emitting plasma. Here, we argue that winds driven by energy-injection in a ring-like geometry can produce this distinctive large-scale multi-phase morphology.

arxiv-2302-03589.title: CALaMo: a Constructionist Assessment of Language Models
arxiv-2302-03589.creator: Ludovica Pannitto, Aurélie Herbelot
arxiv-2302-03589.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel framework for evaluating Neural Language Models’ linguistic abilities using a constructionist approach. Not only is the usage-based model in line with the underlying stochastic philosophy of neural architectures, but it also allows the linguist to keep meaning as a determinant factor in the analysis.

arxiv-2303-03122.title: SELLA - A Program for Determining Bravais Lattice Types
arxiv-2303-03122.creator: Herbert J, Nicholas K
arxiv-2303-03122.description: Abstract We introduce a new Bravais lattice determination algorithm. SELLA is a straight-forward algorithm and a program for determining Bravais lattice type based on Selling (Delone) reduction. It is a complete, closed solution, and it provides a clear metric of fit to each type. \journalcode A August 7, 2026 \cauthor [a]Lawrence C.Andrewslawrence.andrews@ronininstitute.

arxiv-2307-12779.title: Launching Drifter Observations in the Presence of Uncertainty
arxiv-2307-12779.creator: Nan Chen, Evelyn Lunasin, Stephen Wiggins
arxiv-2307-12779.description: Abstract Determining the optimal locations for placing extra observational measurements has practical significance. However, the exact underlying flow field is never known in practice. Significant uncertainty appears when the flow field is inferred from a limited number of existing observations via data assimilation or statistical forecast.

arxiv-2407-11485.title: Scientific QA System with Verifiable Answers
arxiv-2407-11485.creator: Adela Ljajić 1, Miloš Košprdić 1, Bojana Bašaragin 1, Darija Medvecki 1, Lorenzo Cassano 2 Nikola Milošević 1 2 1 Institute for Artificial Intelligence Research and Development of Serbia, Novi Sad, Serbia 2 Bayer A.G, Berlin, Germany
arxiv-2407-11485.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Adela Ljajić 1, Miloš Košprdić 1, Bojana Bašaragin 1, Darija Medvecki 1, Lorenzo Cassano 2 Nikola Milošević 1 2 1 Institute for Artificial Intelligence Research and Development of Serbia, Novi Sad, Serbia 2 Bayer A.G, Berlin, Germany. In this paper, we introduce the Verif.ai project , a pioneering open-source scientific question-answering system, designed to provide answers that are not only referenced but also automatically vetted and verifiable.

arxiv-2409-02362.title: Bundled matrix product states represent low-energy excitations faithfully
arxiv-2409-02362.creator: Thomas E. Baker, Negar Seif
arxiv-2409-02362.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Thomas E. Baker, Negar Seif. We consider a set of density matrices. All of which are written in the same orbital basis, but the orbital basis size is less than the total Hilbert space size. We ask how each density matrix is related to each of the others by establishing a norm between density matrices based on the truncation error in a partial trace for a small set of orbitals.

arxiv-2510-16742.title: Surrogate Modeling and Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Complex Systems: A Workflow for Automated Simulation Exploration
arxiv-2510-16742.creator: Paul Saves, Pramudita Satria Palar, Muhammad Daffa Robani, Nicolas Verstaevel, Moncef Garouani, Julien Aligon, Benoit Gaudou, Koji Shimoyama, Joseph Morlier
arxiv-2510-16742.description: Abstract Complex systems are increasingly explored through simulation-driven engineering workflows that combine physics-based and empirical models with optimization and analytics. Despite their power, these workflows face two central obstacles: (1) high computational cost, since accurate exploration requires many expensive simulator runs; and (2) limited transparency and reliability when decisions rely on opaque blackbox components.

pmc-10573900.title: Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells: A New Frontier in the Management of Patients with Diabetes and No-Option Critical Limb Ischaemia
pmc-10573900.creator: Marco Meloni, Laura Giurato, Aikaterini Andreadi, Ermanno Bellizzi, Alfonso Bellia, Davide Lauro, Luigi Uccioli
pmc-10573900.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The current study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PB-MNC) therapy as adjuvant treatment for patients with diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) and no-option critical limb ischaemia (NO-CLI). The study is a prospective, noncontrolled, observational study including patients with neuro-ischaemic DFUs and NO-CLI who had unsuccessful revascularization below the ankle (BTA) and persistence of foot ischaemia defined by TcPO2 values less than 30 mmHg.

pmc-11506057.title: Identification of Podoplanin Aptamers by SELEX for Protein Detection and Inhibition of Platelet Aggregation Stimulated by C-Type Lectin-like Receptor 2
pmc-11506057.creator: Hui-Ju Tsai, Kai-Wen Cheng, Jou-Chen Li, Tsai-Xiang Ruan, Ting-Hsin Chang, Jin-Ru Wang, Ching-Ping Tseng
pmc-11506057.description: Tumor cell-induced platelet aggregation (TCIPA) is a mechanism for the protection of tumor cells in the bloodstream and the promotion of tumor progression and metastases. The platelet C-type lectin-like receptor 2 (CLEC-2) can bind podoplanin (PDPN) on a cancer cell surface to facilitate TCIPA. Selective blockage of PDPN-mediated platelet–tumor cell interaction is a plausible strategy for inhibiting metastases.

pmc-11646258.title: Emotional Competences in Adolescents Exposed to Colombian Armed Conflict During Their Childhood
pmc-11646258.creator: Diego Armando León-Rodríguez, Catalina Moncaleano
pmc-11646258.description: Objective: Analyse the mediation role of emotional competences on behavior problems in adolescents exposed to Armed-Conflict Childhood Adversities (ACCA). Method: Families with adolescent children who studied in three schools in the municipality of Soacha, Colombia, were invited to participate in the study.

pmc-12639556.title: LCMV-mediated loss of virtual memory CD8 T cells yields a functionally enhanced T cell subset
pmc-12639556.creator: Tabinda Hussain, Angela Nguyen, Daniel Thiele, Dulakara Kannangara, Zijian Huang, Ee Shan Pang, Alana Kirn, Sammy Bedoui, Kim L Good-Jacobson, Meredith O’Keeffe, Kylie M Quinn, Nicole L La Gruta
pmc-12639556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryThe unique cytokine responsiveness of virtual memory T (TVM) cells endows them with a potent capacity for bystander activation and effector function. Here, we investigated the antigen-independent impact of microbial infections on TVM cells. While Salmonella typhimurium or influenza A virus had no discernible effect, infection with lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) resulted in a rapid and profound depletion of TVM and true naive (TN) cells.

pmc-13251735.title: Connect Kits for Family Action: Intervention Development and Exploratory Data Analysis of Proximal Outcomes
pmc-13251735.creator: Kelli A. Komro, Juli R. Skinner, Emily Ivanich, Caroline M. Barry, Ashna Jagtiani, Bethany J. Livingston, Sierra L. Talavera-Brown, Hannah LaBounty, Ashley N. Gassaway, Melvin D. Livingston
pmc-13251735.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We designed a home-based family intervention to address risk of substance use among adolescents in rural and Native American communities. Through a Tribal-University partnership, study aims were to develop, implement and explore effects on proximal risk and protective factors. The study was conducted in or near the Cherokee Nation Reservation in northeastern Oklahoma and was a cluster-randomized trial with 10 high schools randomly assigned to intervention and 10 to delayed intervention group.

pmc-13386769.title: Adolescent with cannabis use disorder and other mental health disorders: does dual disorder worsen school impairment?
pmc-13386769.creator: J. L. Matali, E. Flores, X. Estrada-Prat, A. Bonillo
pmc-13386769.description: IntroductionDespite evidence of the impact on academic performance of cannabis use disorder (CUD) there is little information about what happens in those cases of dual diagnosis, when CUD occurs along with other mental health disorders (DD).MethodsParticipants in this study (N = 300) were recruited from patients seeking treatment for CUD at an adolescent addictive behaviors unit.

pmc-13503078.title: High prevalence of intestinal colonization by beta-lactam resistant Enterobacterales in patients admitted to an emergency department in Lima, Peru
pmc-13503078.creator: Gustavo Gutierrez Batallanos, Alvaro Madrid, Edwin Varillas, Noemi Hinostroza, Fiorella Krapp
pmc-13503078.description: ObjectivesTo determine the prevalence of intestinal colonization by extended-spectrum beta-lactamase-producing Enterobacterales (ESBL-E) and carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales (CRE) among patients admitted to the emergency department of a tertiary care hospital in Lima, Peru. Factors associated with colonization were also evaluated.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted from December 2019 to March 2020. Patients were enrolled on one to two randomly selected days per week.

pmc-13573617.title: Bilayer of Indium Phthalocyanine Molecules on Pb(001): Structure and Spin States
pmc-13573617.creator: Niklas Ide, Arnab Banerjee, Alexander Weismann, Roberto Robles, Nicolás Lorente, Richard Berndt
pmc-13573617.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Bilayers of the nonplanar complex indium phthalocyanine (InPc) were studied on superconducting Pb(001) using scanning tunneling microscopy and density functional theory calculations. The structure of the bilayer is drastically different from that of a single layer in terms of the unit cell, the azimuthal orientations of the molecules, and the position of the In ion above (In↑Pc) or below (In↓Pc) the macrocycle. Intriguingly, the presence of the second layer appears to induce a geometric transition of the first layer.
